outcome: hospital readmission for fatal or non-fatal CVD
cohort: The study included 14,179,299 singleton delivery hospitalisations in the United States from Jan 1, 2010 to Nov 30, 2018, involving patients aged 15-54 without pre-existing CVD.
finding: Caesarean delivery of singletons was associated with a higher risk of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality within one year compared to vaginal delivery, with the highest risk in the first month.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with a significantly higher risk (HR 1.42) of cardiovascular readmission within one year compared to vaginal delivery, with the risk being highest in the first 0-29 days postpartum (HR 1.68).
